twoLeg.note: Legs are in different games, so the dependence is only through shared week-level information and market structure. Compare observed vs modelled joint rate.

threeLeg.note: No model joint probability is published for three legs because the legs were selected by edge size, which biases any independence calculation.

correlationLesson: A parlay priced by multiplying marginals is only correct when phi = 0. Where phi is materially non-zero the fair price moves, and the direction is given by the sign of phi: positive dependence makes the product price too generous to the bettor; negative dependence makes it too generous to the book.
